plantedBugs.description: Worker path is relative ./scorer.js — in bundled or distributed code, the worker script path may not resolve. Should use __dirname or workerData for path resolution.
Message handler is shared across all tasks — if a worker completes a task after a timeout, the wrong promise may be resolved. Need task ID correlation.
No worker error handling — if a worker crashes, the pool loses a worker permanently and queued tasks stall. Should respawn crashed workers.
No backpressure or queue limit — unbounded queue can grow until OOM under load. Should limit queue size and reject or shed load.
